main_body: Snow-covered conifer: a tall conical canopy in stacked tiers with snow lying on each tier, and a short brown trunk at the bottom
top_band: Column x=16: snow band rows 12-14 (L 228/200/166) sits on top of the dark green tier below (rows 16-21, L~59). The apex cap is rows 2-3 (L200). Further snow bands follow at rows 24-26, 33-35 and 44-46.
evidence: Each tier has a light snow shelf of 2-3 rows, tapering from L228 to L166 at its front edge. Directly below it is a dark green tier face of 6-10 rows, with an abrupt step of well over 25 L. The snow shelves read as horizontal surfaces seen from above, over the green fronts of the tiers. The cone silhouette is not a flat elevation, and no isometric side face is drawn. It is a borderline organic piece but passes as a tiered 3/4 conifer.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 15 distinct colours and a median of 9 colours per tile, against 427-567 colours and a median of 108 per tile for the references. That is far below both. The greens run in about 4-5 steps (L22, 40, 55-68, 89, 116) and the snow in about 4 (249, 228, 200, 166). The outline is a dark green-teal tint with 0% neutral edge pixels, so it is material-toned and not a sticker line. There are no 5x5 flat fills. But the foliage has no leaf clumps or per-cluster highlights, so it is a banded cone beside the richly textured references and looks thinner and flatter next to them.
